message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the **long‑weekend** holidays that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday, giving you a three‑day break (Friday–Sunday or Monday–Wednesday).  

| Date | Holiday | Day of Week | Notes |
|------|---------|-------------|-------|
| **April 7** | Good Friday | Friday | Creates a long weekend (Fri‑Sun). |
| **May 24** | Victoria Day | Monday | Creates a long weekend (Mon‑Wed). |
| **July 1** | Canada Day | Monday | Creates a long weekend (Mon‑Wed). |
| **September 4** | Labour Day | Monday | Creates a long weekend (Mon‑Wed). |
| **October 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | Creates a long weekend (Mon‑Wed). |

> **Other holidays that fell on a weekday (not a long weekend):**  
> - New Year’s Day (Jan 1 – Sunday)  
> - Family Day (Ontario – Feb 20 – Monday – *creates a long weekend* in Ontario only)  
> - Remembrance Day (Nov 11 – Monday – *creates a long weekend* in some provinces)  
> - Christmas Day (Dec 25 – Monday – *creates a long weekend* in most provinces)  
> - Boxing Day (Dec 26 – Tuesday – *does not create a long weekend*).  

If you’re building your app, you can use the above table to flag the dates that give users a natural 3‑day break. Feel free to let me know if you’d like the data in JSON format or if you need provincial variations!
